title: feat(streaming,search): add AI token streaming plugin and subsequence fuzzy matcher

reviews.body:
## Pull request overview Adds a new CodeMirror-based streaming plugin to support AI token delta injection with a typing-cursor decoration, and extends the existing search plugin with a subsequence fuzzy matcher (with scoring + position extraction) aligned to the roadmap and OpenSpec change. **Changes:** - Introduce `@floatboat/nexus-plugin-streaming` with session state/effects, a cursor widget decoration, and a `StreamingManager` API. - Add subsequence fuzzy matching via `findFuzzyMatches()` and integrate it behind `findSearchMatches(..., { fuzzy: true })`. - Update workspace wiring (tsconfig paths, root build script, lockfile) and document roadmap/spec artifacts. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 14 out of 15 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | tsconfig.base.json | Adds TS path alias for the new streaming plugin package. | | pnpm-lock.yaml | Registers the new `packages/plugin-streaming` importer dependencies. | | packages/plugin-streaming/tsconfig.json | Adds TS config for the new package including `src/` and `test/`. | | packages/plugin-streaming/test/streaming.test.ts | New Vitest coverage for streaming session lifecycle and chunk insertion. | | packages/plugin-streaming/src/streaming-plugin.ts | Implements streaming session StateField/effects, cursor decoration, and `StreamingManager`. | | packages/plugin-streaming/src/index.ts | Exposes the streaming plugin public API surface. | | packages/plugin-streaming/package.json | New package manifest for publishing/building the streaming plugin. | | packages/plugin-search/test/fuzzy-search.test.ts | Adds unit tests for fuzzy matching behavior and delegation via `findSearchMatches`. | | packages/plugin-search/src/index.ts | Adds `FuzzyMatch`, `findFuzzyMatches()`, and `fuzzy` options integration. | | package.json | Includes streaming plugin in the root build pipeline. | | openspec/specs/plugin-streaming/spec.md | Adds the capability spec for streaming initialization, delta insertion, and cursor decoration. | | openspec/changes/add-plugin-streaming/tasks.md | Tracks implementation checklist for the OpenSpec change. | | openspec/changes/add-plugin-streaming/proposal.md | Records motivation/scope/verification steps for the streaming plugin change. | | docs/ROADMAP.md | Marks fuzzy search roadmap item as done and documents the implemented approach. | | docs/ROADMAP.zh.md | Same roadmap status update and description for the Chinese roadmap. |

review_comments.body:
`startStream()` accepts an arbitrary `atPos` and stores it as `startPos/currentPos` without validating it against the current document length. If a caller passes an out-of-range position, later `appendChunk()` dispatches an invalid change and `streamingDecorationPlugin` can also throw when placing a widget range beyond `doc.length`.

Clamp the position into `[0, doc.length]` before dispatching the effect.

`StreamingPluginOptions` exposes `shimmerClassName`, but the implementation never reads it (the widget/theme always hardcode `"nexus-streaming-cursor"`). This makes the public API misleading because changing `shimmerClassName` has no effect.

Either wire this option through to the decoration + theme, or remove it until it’s supported.

The tests create `EditorView` instances but never call `view.destroy()`. Other CodeMirror-based tests in this repo consistently destroy views to avoid leaking DOM/event handlers across the test suite.

Add a shared cleanup (e.g., `afterEach`) to destroy any views created by `createView()`.

`tsconfig.base.json` adds a path alias for `@floatboat/nexus-plugin-streaming`, but the Vitest alias map (`vitest.config.ts`) is still missing the corresponding entry. In this repo, tests typically rely on Vitest’s `resolve.alias` being kept in sync with TS path aliases; leaving it out can cause `@floatboat/*` imports to work in TS/IDE but fail under Vitest/bundler resolution.

Please add the same alias to `vitest.config.ts`.
